title: Canadian Dream Mall
content: I grew up in a little Michigan town on the Canadian border and have constant reoccurring dreams about all types of things happening in this mall. I’m an old millennial and remember when people could smoke inside, and a lot of the time people in my dreams are smoking inside the mall. I dream about finding a perfect outfit at a store called “Smart Set” that used to exist in the late 90’s/ early 2000’s. Sometimes I meet with people I haven’t seen in years (from all walks of life, not just my hometown) at the Tim Horton’s for an Ice Capp. I buy formal dance dresses, I always find a new wing of the mall I never knew existed, sometimes I realize I’m stuck at the (dream) mall at closing time with no ride back across the American border and it’s cold out. In one memorable dream I saw a witch fly across the full moon on a broomstick when I was in the mall looking up through a skylight that didn’t even exist in the “real life” mall. In real life there is a big glass pyramid sculpture outside of the mall and sometimes it appears in different around the dream mall but I know it’s still that sculpture by it’s “essence”. The mall is always busy and full in my dreams, but I went back not too long ago when I visited my family in my waking life, and it was lifeless and quiet with only a few stores left to hold it down. I hope the dilapidated 2023 brutal real life version never takes over my happy dream mall.
